# `map_from_arrays`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
map_from_arrays(keys, values)
```

Creates a map with a pair of the given key/value arrays. All elements
in keys should not be null

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `map_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT map_from_arrays(array(1.0, 3.0), array('2', '4'));
```

Result:

```text
{1.0:"2",3.0:"4"}
```
